# CANDIDATE: GAP_UP_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large upward gaps often fail to sustain intraday bullishness, creating a short‑side mean‑reversion opportunity. The strategy fades gaps by entering short when the open gaps up >0.5%, price makes a lower high after the first 30‑minute bar, and closes below VWAP.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If opening gap up > 0.5% (today's open > prior close * 1.005) AND price makes a lower high after the first 30‑minute bar (high of bar 2 < high of bar 1) AND close < VWAP, then enter short at the close of that bar. Exit: Stop at the high of the gap‑up opening bar (or 0.5% above entry); target at gap fill level (prior close) or 1.5R, whichever is reached first. Regime hint: Best when VIX < 22 (gap fills more reliable) and after 09:45 to avoid premature exits; avoid days with major news that can sustain the gap.
